headline: SMIC's results shine; Tong Zhenyuan: over 8 years, government subsidies recognized total 2.72 billion US dollars
summary: China's largest foundry reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3.19 billion, up 6.1% quarter on quarter and 33.9% year on year. Gross margin was 29.9% and operating profit was $710 million.
why: SMIC is China's largest contract chipmaker, and its results indicate demand and capacity utilisation in the domestic semiconductor supply chain.
